name: Escapees
summary:
Escapees is a chaotic multiplayer VR game where you run from monsters, explore wild player-made maps, and build your own worlds without ever leaving VR.

Team up with friends, make weird maps together, place monsters, add lights and spawns, then jump straight in and see if you can survive what you created. Every map can feel completely different, and the more people you bring along, the more ridiculous it gets.

Build it. Play it. Get chased. Repeat.
